name: Artichoke
siboNotes: Artichokes are very high in fructans and should be completely avoided during SIBO elimination phases. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Artichoke hearts in brine may be slightly lower in FODMAPs than fresh
Remove all tough outer leaves and choke completely
If attempting small amounts, start with canned hearts which may be more tolerable
Consider infusing oil with artichoke flavor instead of eating the vegetable itself
